questions.question: What are you doing? I am ... a story book.
questions.explanation: Membaca buku cerita menggunakan kata kerja 'reading'.

questions.question: Look! Budi is ... fried rice in the dining room.
questions.explanation: Makan nasi goreng dinyatakan dengan kata 'eating'.

questions.question: Siti and Nina are in the kitchen. They are ... orange juice.
questions.explanation: Meminum jus jeruk dinyatakan dengan kata kerja 'drinking'.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'I ... studying English right now.'
questions.explanation: Subjek 'I' selalu berpasangan dengan to be 'am'.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'He ... playing football in the yard.'
questions.explanation: Subjek tunggal laki-laki 'He' berpasangan dengan to be 'is'.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'They ... swimming in the pool.'
questions.explanation: Subjek jamak 'They' berpasangan dengan to be 'are'.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'writing a letter'?
questions.explanation: 'Writing a letter' berarti menulis surat.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'sleeping on the bed'?
questions.explanation: 'Sleeping' berarti tidur, 'bed' adalah tempat tidur/kasur.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: 'Mother is ... delicious soup for dinner.'
questions.explanation: Memasak sup lezat menggunakan kata kerja 'cooking'.

questions.question: Choose the correct verb: 'The boys are ... bicycle in the park.'
questions.explanation: Mengendarai sepeda menggunakan kata kerja 'riding'.

questions.question: Ahmad: 'What is your sister doing?' - Fatimah: 'She ... drawing a cat.'
questions.explanation: Subjek 'She' berpasangan dengan to be 'is'.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'We ... singing a national song together.'
questions.explanation: Subjek jamak 'We' berpasangan dengan to be 'are'.

questions.question: What are the students doing in the library? They are ... quietly.
questions.explanation: Di perpustakaan, murid membaca buku dengan tenang.

questions.question: What is the negative form of 'She is sleeping'?
questions.explanation: Bentuk negatif: tambahkan 'not' setelah to be 'is'.

questions.question: Change into interrogative (question): 'You are studying math.'
questions.explanation: Kalimat tanya continuous: letakkan to be 'Are' di awal kalimat.

questions.question: Look at the picture: Doni is holding a pencil and paper. What is he doing?
options: He is driving a big car.
questions.explanation: Memegang pensil dan kertas menandakan aktivitas menggambar.

questions.question: Rina: 'Is your father watching television?' - Edo: 'Yes, ...'
questions.explanation: Ayah adalah 'he', jawaban singkat positif: 'Yes, he is.'

questions.question: Lani: 'Are you listening to the radio?' - Dayu: 'No, ...'
questions.explanation: Pertanyaan 'Are you' dijawab oleh orang pertama: 'No, I am not.'

questions.question: Complete the verb: 'swim' becomes ... in present continuous tense.
questions.explanation: Aturan ejaan: konsonan rangkap pada kata berakhiran vokal-konsonan pendek.

questions.question: Complete the verb: 'run' becomes ... in present continuous tense.
questions.explanation: Kata 'run' menjadi 'running' dengan menggandakan huruf 'n'.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence in present continuous tense:
options: The children are playing hide and seek.
The children is playing hide and seek.
The children am playing hide and seek.
The children playing hide and seek are.
questions.explanation: 'Children' adalah bentuk jamak dari 'child', memakai to be 'are'.

questions.question: What is Mr. Rahman doing? He is a teacher. He is ... the students.
questions.explanation: Sebagai seorang guru, aktivitasnya adalah mengajar ('teaching').

questions.question: Translate into English: 'Kami sedang membersihkan ruang kelas.'
questions.explanation: 'Kami sedang membersihkan' diterjemahkan 'We are cleaning'.

questions.question: Translate into English: 'Dia (perempuan) sedang menyiram bunga.'
questions.explanation: 'She is watering the flowers' adalah kalimat continuous yang tepat.

questions.question: Choose the correct question: '... they playing basketball now?'
questions.explanation: Subjek 'they' membutuhkan to be 'Are' untuk kalimat tanya continuous.

questions.question: Which sentence shows an activity happening right now?
options: My brother washed his bike yesterday afternoon.
My brother is washing his bike at the moment.
My brother will wash his bike tomorrow morning.
My brother washes his bike every single Sunday.
questions.explanation: Present continuous ('is washing ... at the moment') menyatakan kejadian sekarang.

questions.question: Arrange into a good sentence: 'drinking - milk - is - cat - the'
questions.explanation: Susunan kalimat SPO: Subject (The cat) + is + drinking + milk.

questions.question: Arrange into a good sentence: 'guitar - playing - are - they - the'
questions.explanation: Susunan kalimat yang tepat: They are playing the guitar.

questions.question: Error identification: Find the incorrect word in 'The cats is sleeping on the mat.'
questions.explanation: Kata 'cats' adalah jamak, to be yang benar seharusnya 'are', bukan 'is'.

questions.question: Sentence correction: 'Listen! Somebody are knocking on the door.'
questions.explanation: 'Somebody' adalah kata ganti tunggal (singular), sehingga memakai 'is'.

questions.question: Context analysis: When the teacher says 'Be quiet! I am explaining the lesson,' students should ...
questions.explanation: Makna konteks kalimat mengajak siswa menyimak penjelasan guru dengan hening.

questions.question: Dialogue completion: Sarah: '...?' - Hana: 'I am helping my mother in the kitchen.'
questions.explanation: Jawaban aktivitas continuous diawali pertanyaan 'What are you doing?'.

questions.question: Value integration: Helping a friend who is cleaning the board shows ...
questions.explanation: Membantu kawan yang sedang piket mencerminkan kasih sayang dan kerjasama.

questions.question: Grammar analysis: Why does 'write' become 'writing' without the letter 'e'?
options: because the letter 'e' is too difficult to read
verbs ending in silent 'e' drop the 'e' before -ing
because all English verbs must have seven letters
so that the word sounds like an Arabic word
questions.explanation: Aturan fonetik: kata kerja berakhiran huruf 'e' luluh saat ditambah akhiran -ing.

questions.question: Complex sentence: 'While Budi is studying in his room, his sister ... a doll.'
questions.explanation: Subjek 'his sister' tunggal, sehingga menggunakan 'is playing with'.

questions.question: What is the English word for number 50?
questions.explanation: Angka 50 dalam bahasa Inggris adalah 'fifty' (15 adalah fifteen).

questions.question: What is the English word for number 60?
questions.explanation: Angka 60 adalah 'sixty'.

questions.question: What is the English word for number 70?
questions.explanation: Angka 70 adalah 'seventy'.

questions.question: What is the English word for number 80?
questions.explanation: Angka 80 adalah 'eighty'.

questions.question: What is the English word for number 90?
questions.explanation: Angka 90 adalah 'ninety'.

questions.question: What is the English word for number 100?
questions.explanation: Angka 100 adalah 'one hundred'.

questions.question: How do you spell number 55 in English words?
questions.explanation: Kombinasi puluhan dan satuan: fifty-five.

questions.question: How do you spell number 67 in English words?
questions.explanation: Angka 67 ditulis 'sixty-seven'.

questions.question: How do you spell number 84 in English words?
questions.explanation: Angka 84 ditulis 'eighty-four'.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: '... is an apple on the table.'
questions.explanation: Satu buah apel ('an apple') tunggal menggunakan 'There is'.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: '... are five pencils in my pencil case.'
questions.explanation: Ungkapan keberadaan benda jamak menggunakan 'There are'.

questions.question: How many days are there in a week? There are ... days.
questions.explanation: Ada tujuh hari dalam satu minggu ('seven days').

questions.question: What is 'twenty plus thirty'?
Complete the sentence: 'There ... seventy students in the school hall.'
questions.explanation: Tujuh puluh murid ('seventy students') adalah jamak, menggunakan 'are'.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'There ... one whiteboard in our classroom.'
questions.explanation: Satu papan tulis ('one whiteboard') adalah tunggal, menggunakan 'is'.

questions.question: What is the result of 'seventy-five minus fifteen'?
What is the result of 'forty plus forty-eight'?
questions.explanation: 40 + 48 = 88 ('eighty-eight').

questions.question: Question to ask quantity: '... books are there on the bookshelf?'
questions.explanation: Benda yang dapat dihitung (countable) ditanyakan dengan 'How many'.

questions.question: Rudi has 52 marbles. His father gives him 10 more marbles. How many marbles does Rudi have now?
Choose the correct plural noun form: 'There are two ... in the room.'
questions.explanation: Benda berakhiran 'ch' mendapat akhiran '-es' saat jamak: watches.

questions.question: Choose the correct plural noun form: 'There are three ... under the tree.'
questions.explanation: Benda berakhiran 'x' mendapat akhiran '-es' saat jamak: boxes.

questions.question: Translate into English: 'Ada sembilan puluh kursi di ruangan itu.'
options: There is ninety chairs in the room.
There are ninety chairs in the room.
There are nineteen chairs in the room.
There is nineteen chairs in the room.
questions.explanation: 'Ada 90 kursi' diterjemahkan 'There are ninety chairs'.

questions.question: Translate into English: 'Berapa banyak penghapus yang ada di sana?'
questions.explanation: Penghapus dapat dihitung jamak: 'How many erasers are there?'.

questions.question: Look at the number sequence: 50, 60, 70, ..., 90. What is the missing number?
questions.explanation: Pola bertambah 10: 70 + 10 = 80 ('eighty').

questions.question: Look at the number sequence: 65, 70, 75, ..., 85. What is the missing number?
questions.explanation: Pola bertambah 5: 75 + 5 = 80 ('eighty').

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'There is' correctly?
options: There is ten rulers in my bag.
There is a ruler in my bag.
There is many rulers in my bag.
There is two rulers in my bag.
questions.explanation: 'There is' hanya dipakai untuk benda tunggal ('a ruler').

questions.question: Mathematical problem: 'A library has 95 story books. 25 books are borrowed by students. How many books are left?'
questions.explanation: 95 - 25 = 70 ('seventy books').

questions.question: Sentence correction: 'There is many pictures hanging on the wall.'
questions.explanation: 'Many pictures' adalah bentuk jamak, harus menggunakan 'are'.

questions.question: Error identification: Find the mistake in 'There are fifty-four student in the laboratory.'
questions.explanation: Setelah bilangan lebih dari satu, kata benda harus berbentuk jamak ('students').

questions.question: Comparison analysis: 'Class A has 38 students. Class B has 42 students. How many students are there in total?'
questions.explanation: 38 + 42 = 80 ('eighty students').

questions.question: Critical spelling: Which word is spelled correctly for number 40?
questions.explanation: Angka 40 dieja 'forty' tanpa huruf 'u'.

questions.question: Value integration: Sharing 10 pencils with classmates who forgot their pens reflects ...
questions.explanation: Berbagi alat tulis mencerminkan kedermawanan dan kasih sayang kepada sahabat.

questions.question: Contextual logic: If a box can hold 50 apples, how many apples can 2 similar boxes hold?
questions.explanation: 50 x 2 = 100 ('one hundred apples').

questions.question: Where do you sleep at night? In the ...
questions.explanation: Kamar tidur dalam bahasa Inggris adalah 'bedroom'.

questions.question: Where does mother cook delicious meals? In the ...
questions.explanation: Dapur tempat memasak makanan disebut 'kitchen'.

questions.question: Where do you take a bath and brush your teeth? In the ...
questions.explanation: Kamar mandi tempat membersihkan diri disebut 'bathroom'.

questions.question: Where does the family gather to watch television? In the ...
questions.explanation: Ruang keluarga tempat berkumpul dan menonton TV adalah 'living room'.

questions.question: Where does father park his car or motorcycle? In the ...
questions.explanation: Garasi tempat memarkir kendaraan disebut 'garage'.

questions.question: The cat is sleeping ... the table. (di bawah)
questions.explanation: Preposisi 'di bawah' adalah 'under'.

questions.question: The vase of flowers is ... the table. (di atas)
questions.explanation: Preposisi 'di atas' menempel permukaan adalah 'on'.

questions.question: The fish is swimming ... the aquarium. (di dalam)
questions.explanation: Preposisi 'di dalam' ruang atau wadah adalah 'in'.

questions.question: The broom is ... the door. (di belakang)
questions.explanation: Preposisi 'di belakang' adalah 'behind'.

questions.question: The teacher is standing ... the classroom. (di depan)
questions.explanation: Preposisi 'di depan' adalah 'in front of'.

questions.question: The bedside table is ... the bed. (di samping)
questions.explanation: Preposisi 'di samping' atau di sebelah adalah 'beside' / 'next to'.

questions.question: What is the meaning of 'dining room'?
questions.explanation: 'Dining room' adalah ruangan tempat menyantap makanan bersama.

questions.question: What furniture do you sit on in the living room?
questions.explanation: 'Sofa' adalah kursi busa empuk tempat duduk di ruang tamu.

questions.question: The ball is ... the two boxes. (di antara dua benda)
questions.explanation: Preposisi 'di antara dua objek' adalah 'between'.

questions.question: Where do you keep fresh vegetables and cold milk in the kitchen?
questions.explanation: Kulkas/lemari es ('refrigerator') menjaga makanan tetap segar.

questions.question: Where do you hang your clean clothes and school uniform?
questions.explanation: Lemari pakaian tempat menggantung baju adalah 'wardrobe'.

questions.question: Complete the sentence: 'The kitchen is ... the dining room.'
questions.explanation: 'Next to' bermakna berdampingan di sebelah ruangan lain.

questions.question: Ahmad: 'Where is my school bag?' - Mother: 'It is ... the chair.'
questions.explanation: Tas sekolah diletakkan di atas kursi memakai preposisi 'on'.

questions.question: Translate into English: 'Ada sebuah lampu gantung di atas meja makan.'
options: There are a lamp under the dining table.
There is a lamp inside the dining table.
There is a lamp above the dining table.
There are lamps behind the dining table.
questions.explanation: Posisi melayang di atas tanpa menempel menggunakan 'above'.

questions.question: Translate into English: 'Kucing itu sedang bersembunyi di belakang lemari.'
options: The cat is hiding under the wardrobe.
The cat is hiding in front of the wardrobe.
The cat is hiding on the wardrobe.
The cat is hiding behind the wardrobe.
questions.explanation: 'Di belakang lemari' diterjemahkan 'behind the wardrobe'.

questions.question: Describe the room: 'There is a stove, a pan, and a refrigerator.' This room is a ...
questions.explanation: Kompor, wajan, dan kulkas berada di dapur ('kitchen').

questions.question: Describe the room: 'There is a bed, a pillow, and a study desk.' This room is a ...
questions.explanation: Tempat tidur, bantal, dan meja belajar berada di kamar tidur ('bedroom').

questions.question: Which preposition means the opposite of 'in front of'?
questions.explanation: Lawan kata dari 'di depan' (in front of) adalah 'di belakang' (behind).

questions.question: Which preposition means the opposite of 'under'?
questions.explanation: Lawan kata dari 'di bawah' (under) adalah 'di atas' (on/above).

questions.question: Arrange into a good sentence: 'garden - the - is - house - behind - the'
options: The garden is behind the house.
The garden behind is the house.
Behind the house the garden is.
The house is the garden behind.
questions.explanation: Susunan yang benar: The garden is behind the house.

questions.question: Arrange into a good sentence: 'shoes - are - the - bed - under - the'
options: The shoes under are the bed.
The shoes are under the bed.
Under the bed are shoes the.
The bed are the shoes under.
questions.explanation: Susunan yang benar: The shoes are under the bed.

questions.question: Reading comprehension: 'Fajar puts his shoes under the bench, his bag on the desk, and his jacket behind the door. Where is his bag?'
questions.explanation: Berdasarkan teks, tas ('his bag') diletakkan di atas meja ('on the desk').

questions.question: Spatial reasoning: 'The bank is between the post office and the library. Where is the bank?'
options: in the middle of the post office and the library
questions.explanation: 'Between' menunjukkan posisi di tengah-tengah antara dua tempat.

questions.question: House layout analysis: 'If the garage is beside the house, father can park his car ...'
questions.explanation: Garasi di sebelah rumah memberikan akses parkir yang aman di samping bangunan.

questions.question: Sentence correction: 'The dog is sleeping in the chair floor under.'
options: The dog sleeping under is the chair.
The dog is sleeping under the chair.
Under the chair sleeping is the dog.
The chair is sleeping under the dog.
questions.explanation: Urutan yang benar: Subjek + to be + verb-ing + preposisi tempat.

questions.question: Value integration: Keeping our bedroom tidy, clean, and organized shows ...
questions.explanation: Merapikan kamar tidur sendiri melatih tanggung jawab dan kemandirian hidup.

questions.question: Environmental care: Planting flowers and trees in the garden in front of the house helps ...
options: make the house hot and crowded
destroy the fence of the house
make the air fresh, cool, and beautiful
questions.explanation: Menghijaukan taman pekarangan rumah menyegarkan udara dan menyejukkan pandangan.
